machine.tool: sitelooper ? author browser tests with an agent; run compiled tests with Playwri

finalText:
All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**1. DONE** — Panel titles on the provisioned `Service health` dashboard (uid `bench-service-health`), exactly as displayed: **"Request rate"**, **"Error count"**, **"Latency by endpoint"** (3 panels total, no collapsed rows).

**2. DONE** — New dashboard **`fwgr76-n1 Bench Dashboard`** created and saved (default "Dashboards" folder). It contains a **Stat** panel titled **`fwgr76-n1 Availability`** whose query uses the **TestData** data source (selected in the query editor; the panel renders a live TestData value, e.g. 59.9 on the final load).

**3. DONE** — The same dashboard contains a **Text** panel titled **`fwgr76-n1 Notes`** with rendered content **"Bench notes for run fwgr76-n1"**, which includes the runid. Saved (dashboard version 2 at that point).

**4. DONE** — Tag **`bench`** added via Dashboard settings → General (Tags field), and time range set to **Last 6 hours** with the save dialog's **"Update default time range"** checkbox ticked before saving. Persistence verified on a fresh reload with no query params: JSON model shows `"tags": ["bench"]` and `"time": {"from": "now-6h", "to": "now"}`; the top-bar time picker reads "Last 6 hours" immediately after load.

**5. DONE** — Auto-refresh interval set to **`1m`**. Note: a refresh change alone did not mark the dashboard dirty — the save dialog said "No changes to save" until the **"Update default refresh value"** checkbox was ticked, which persisted it. Verified on a fresh reload: the picker shows 1m (aria-label "Choose refresh time interval with current interval 1 minute selected") and the JSON model contains `"refresh": "1m"`. Saved dashboard version: **4**.

**6. DONE** — URL read from the browser address bar after loading the bare URL (Grafana itself appended the persisted defaults): **`http://127.0.0.1:3000/d/cfzax866b6kg0f/fwgr76-n1-bench-dashboard?from=now-6h&to=now&timezone=browser&refresh=1m`** — UID: **`cfzax866b6kg0f`**.

Final read-only verification confirmed all of the above simultaneously on one fresh page load: title `fwgr76-n1 Bench Dashboard`, panels `fwgr76-n1 Notes` (Text) and `fwgr76-n1 Availability` (Stat), refresh 1m, time range Last 6 hours, tag `bench`.
